summary: VEILFALL: ASHES OF THE NINE is an isometric action RPG whose active slice is Z01, Broken Lantern Road, from the Wayside Fire through the Dripping Gate. The main-place referee stages the quest and spawns actors, player and enemy behaviors own combat, shared data tunes combat, and scene cells plus procedural generators build the ravine and arena.
places: places/main/ - the active Z01 place: Wayside Fire hub, candle road, tollhouse court, Dripping Gate and Bailiff arena; sim.js coordinates quest and actors.
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - camp and candle-road authored landmarks/dressing, including candle-bearing milestones and the generated Tollhouse.
places/main/cells/x0z-1.scene - Dripping Gate/Bailiff arena and extended candle-road dressing; scene props use shared Veilfall generators.
places/main/config.yaml - main terrain, materials and procedural grass, clover and mushroom layers.
roots: world.config.yaml - world entry: default place main, player and camera templates, lighting, UI, arrival behavior and input actions including I bag and 1 guard.
templates/player.js - player template composing scripts/player.js with scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js on the player character.
templates/camera.js - custom camera template running scripts/camera.js.
places/main/sim.js - place referee: ensures Maelin, petitions, enemy pack and Bailiff exist; advances per-player quest/levels and grants the one-time turn-in reward.
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - authored Wayside Fire and candle-road/court content.
places/main/cells/x0z-1.scene - authored gate, road and Bailiff arena content.
shared: scripts/lib/data/combat.yml - combat tuning consumed by player, wax-pack and Bailiff; includes guard, arc/debt and ledger/Fray parameters.
scripts/lib/data/veilfall-map.js - shared HUB/ROAD/COURTS/GATE coordinates and floor-distance reference.
scripts/gen/hub-kit.js - vector, transform, mesh and composition helpers for hub prop generators.
scripts/gen/vf-kit.js - seeded RNG and modeling helpers for Veilfall generators.
scripts/gen/shapes.js - shared mesh construction helpers for generated wax/arena/landmark geometry.
scripts/wax-pack.js - ordinary enemy manager and combat helpers reused by scripts/bailiff.js for payout.
notableExports: scripts/lib/data/veilfall-map.js - HUB, ROAD, ROAD_HALF, COURTS, GATE, floorDist
ownership: scripts/player.js - per-player hp/edge/tonics, XP/level/gold/kills, quest/inventory/reward fields, movement and death/i-frame state; guardUntil, guardReadyAt and riposte support Afterimage Guard.
places/main/sim.js - per-player Z01 quest stage/dialog, kill baseline, level thresholds and claimed['Z01-MAIN-05'] reward; place music/orchestration state.
scripts/wax-pack.js - ordinary enemy AI/hp/death, player damage, nearby XP/gold/kill payouts and eligible wax shards.
scripts/bailiff.js - boss hp/phases/casts, arena engagement/reset, ledger pillars, walkers and Fray; publishes place.state.boss and records bailiffDownAt.
scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - gait/seat animation and foot grounding; consumes player faceYaw.
scripts/camera.js - camera zoom distance and smoothed follow position.
flows: templates/player.js attaches scripts/player.js; onSpawn initializes player combat state from combat.yml and update owns movement, attacks, healing and death/respawn.
world.config.yaml binds I to bag and 1 to guard → scripts/player.js toggles bagOpen or arms Afterimage Guard; scripts/ui.js reads bagOpen and guardReadyAt for HUD.
scripts/player.js strikes write enemy.state.hp and lastHit → scripts/wax-pack.js resolves ordinary enemy death and pays nearby players XP/gold/kills; eligible kills can award shards.

scripts/wax-pack.js and scripts/bailiff.js check iframesUntil and guardUntil before damaging a player; a caught hit consumes guardUntil and writes riposte → scripts/player.js guardTick ripostes nearby foes.
scripts/bailiff.js spawns phase-II ledger pillars and walkers; player attacks lower pillar hp, while intact pillars increase Fray and boss damage taken by players.
scripts/bailiff.js writes hp/max/phase/engaged/dead/fray/ledgers/cast to place.state.boss → scripts/ui.js renders the boss bar and phase/Fray/ledger guidance.

scripts/bailiff.js marks present eligible players bossKilled on defeat and records place.state.bailiffDownAt → places/main/sim.js advances the stage-gated quest; the referee owns one-time reward claiming.
places/main/sim.js spawns petition objects using scripts/petition.js → trigger entry at quest stage 2 adds that petition to player state; five collected petitions advance the quest.
player.state.talk with Maelin → places/main/sim.js stages the quest; kills since killsAt, petition count and bossKilled drive the road, tollhouse and boss objectives.
Maelin turn-in at quest stage 4 → places/main/sim.js sets claimed['Z01-MAIN-05'], grants ITEM-001/XP/gold and advances to stage 5.
scripts/ui.js reads player quest, combat, inventory and dialogue state plus place.state.boss; it presents the HUD without owning those gameplay values.
scripts/player.js faceYaw → scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js gait orientation; generated props are instantiated by scene cells with script paths and per-instance params/seeds.
behaviorFamilies: scripts/gen/hub-*.js - reusable Wayside Fire camp props, varied by instance params, seed and scene transform; share scripts/gen/hub-kit.js.
scripts/gen/vf-*.js - Broken Lantern Road landmarks and clutter, including milestone, props and Tollhouse, varied by parameters/seeds and built with scripts/gen/vf-kit.js.
scripts/gen/arena-floor.js, arena-pillar.js, gibbet.js and toll-throne.js - Bailiff arena dressing generators sharing scripts/gen/shapes.js.
scripts/gen/wax-figure.js - shared wax character mesh for ordinary pilgrims/deacons and Bailiff, varied by kind and seed.
scripts/grass.js, scripts/clover.js and scripts/mushroom.js - procedural vegetation scatter layers configured in places/main/config.yaml; grass appearance uses scripts/grass-look.js.
migrationNotes: Player attacks directly mutate enemy.state.hp; ordinary-enemy death, XP and kill credit are resolved later by scripts/wax-pack.js, so preserve that handoff.
Quest stage, killsAt, petition IDs and claimed rewards are per-player state; petition triggers count only at stage 2 and ITEM-001 is guarded by claimed['Z01-MAIN-05'].
Boss attacks and ordinary enemy attacks consume the same player guardUntil and write riposte; scripts/player.js owns the riposte reaction and must retain this state handoff.
The boss HUD consumes place.state.boss projection (including fray and ledgers), not boss internals; retain its published fields when changing boss behavior.

scripts/lib/data/combat.yml is the runtime tuning source: values are units such as seconds/meters, and Bailiff now uses Taxman's Arc/Unpaid Debt, ledger adds and Fray rather than the earlier slam/pool model.
Scene-cell generators receive their geometry variation through params and seed; maintain the vf-kit/generator contracts and keep scene placements pointing at the matching script paths.
